articles.title: 10-year bond yield crosses 7% as RBI trims auction bids
articles.description: On Friday, benchmark government bond yields climbed by five basis points, surpassing the 7% threshold. The Reserve Bank of India managed to accept less than half of the amount it had targeted in a three-year bond auction. Factors such as high global risk-free rates and escalating crude oil prices are exerting pressure on Indian bonds.

articles.title: Madhya Pradesh Scooty Yojana 2026: Over 7,500 Meritorious Students To Get Scooters On September 16, ₹200 Crore Allocated
articles.description: Over 7,500 meritorious Class 12 students in Madhya Pradesh will receive scooters under the state government’s Scooty Yojana on September 16. Around ₹200 crore has been allocated for the scheme. Eligible students receive ₹1 lakh to ₹1.25 lakh to buy petrol or electric scooters, with e-scooters gaining preference this year.

articles.title: Tensions Escalate: East-West Pipeline Attack and Its Global Implications
articles.description: Saudi Arabia closed its East-West pipeline following a drone attack allegedly originating in Iraq. The attack, possibly linked to Iran-backed militias, highlights escalating tensions in the Middle East. As Houthi rebels gain strategic positions in Yemen, global oil prices surge, putting pressure on international diplomatic and military relations.

articles.title: Houthis seize an island, opening a new front in the Iran war, as Saudi Arabia shuts down a pipeline
articles.description: Officials say Yemen’s Iranian-backed Houthi rebels have captured a strategic island at the southern entrance to the Red Sea. The advance opens a new front in the Iran war and further threatens oil exports from Saudi Arabia, which shut down a major pipeline after it was attacked. The Houthis made their biggest territorial gains in years along the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, one of the world’s key shipping lanes. The gains could boost Iran’s strategy of driving up world oil and gas prices to pressure the United States. Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia said it had shut down the East-West pipeline as a precaution after it was attacked the day before.
